title: The Essence of Learning
english_paragraphs: Once, a student asked his teacher, “Teacher, could you tell me the essence of all your wisdom? Then I could become as wise as you.”

The teacher smiled, picked up an apple, and took a big bite. He looked at his student as he chewed it. After a while, he spat the chewed-up apple into his hand and held it out to the student. “Eat this!” he said. The student exclaimed in surprise, “Teacher! How... how could I eat that?” The teacher replied, “You know you can’t eat an apple I’ve already chewed. The essence of my wisdom is like this chewed-up apple. I could give it to you directly, but it would have lost its original fresh, sweet taste. To learn, you need to chew things over and experience them for yourself. Many answers can only be found through your own thinking.”

Once, a student asked his teacher, “Teacher, could you tell me the essence of all your wisdom? Then I could become as wise as you.”

The teacher smiled, picked up an apple, and took a big bite. He looked at his student as he chewed it. After a while, he spat the chewed-up apple into his hand and held it out to the student. “Eat this!” he said. The student exclaimed in surprise, “Teacher! How... how could I eat that?” The teacher replied, “You know you can’t eat an apple I’ve already chewed. The essence of my wisdom is like this chewed-up apple. I could give it to you directly, but it would have lost its original fresh, sweet taste. To learn, you need to chew things over and experience them for yourself. Many answers can only be found through your own thinking.”
russian_paragraphs: Одна́жды студе́нт спра́шивал своего́ наста́вника: "Наста́вник, ты не мог бы ска́зать мне су́щность всей твоей му́дрости? Тогдá я мог бы стать та́ким же му́дрым, как ты."

Наста́вник улыбну́лся, взя́л я́блоко и отку́сил от него́ большо́й кусо́к. Он смо́трел на своего́ студе́нта, пока он жевал я́блоко. По́сле неко́торого вре́мени он сплю́нул жева́нное я́блоко к себе́ в ру́ку и протя́нул его́ студе́нту. "Съешь э́то!" — ска́зал он. Студе́нт воскли́кнул с сюрпри́зом: "Наста́вник! Как... как я могу́ съесть э́то?" Наста́вник ответи́л: "Ты зна́ешь, ты не смо́жешь съесть я́блоко, кото́рое я уже́ жевал. Су́щность моей́ му́дрости похо́жа на э́то жева́нное я́блоко. Я мог бы дать её тебе́ напря́му, но оно́ бы потеря́ло свой первонача́льный све́жий, сла́дкий вкус. Чтоб учи́ться, нужно жева́ть вещи́ и пережива́ть их самостоя́тельно. Мно́гие отве́ты могут бы́ть найдены только через твоё собственное мы́шление."
reading_paragraphs: Odnázhdy studént spráshival svoegó nastávnika: "Nastávnik, ty ne mog by skázat' mne súshchnost' vséy tvoyey múdrosti? Togdá ya mog by stat' tákim zhe múdrym, kak ty."

Nastávnik ulybnúlsya, vzýal yáboko i otkúsil ot negó bol'shóy kusók. On smotrel na svoegó studénta, poka on zheval yáboko. Pósle nekótorogo vremeni on splýnul zhevánnoye yáboko k sebé v rukú i protýlnul egó studéntu. "S'yesh éto!" — skázal on. Studént vosklíknul s syurprízom: "Nastávnik! Kak... kak ya mogú s'yesh' éto?" Nastávnik otvetil: "Ty znáesh, ty ne smózhesh s'yesh' yáboko, kotoroye ya uzhé zheval. Súshchnost' moyey múdrosti pokhózha na éto zhevánnoye yáboko. Ya mog by dat' yeye tebé naprýamu, no onó by poteryálo svoi̇ pervonachal'ný svézhiy, sladkiy vkus. Chtoby úchit'sya, nuzhno zhevat' veshchí i perezhivat' ikh samostoyátel'no. Mnógiye otvetý mogut být' naydeny tol'ko cherez tvoyo sobstvennoye mýshleniye."
